newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila sees 1997 coconut exports rising.
newsitem.headline: Manila sees 1997 coconut exports rising.

text.p: The Philippine Coconut Authority (PCA) said on Monday it expects coconut exports to reach $900 million in 1997 compared with $867 million the previous year.
PCA Administrator Virgilio David told a news conference that coconut export volume will be about 1.6 to 1.8 million tonnes this year as against 1.5 million in 1996.
David said the rise was due to better harvests.
Earlier, he forecast coconut production for the year at 2.6 million tonnes compared with 2.4 million in 1996.
